finpro.title: FinPro — cash flow & internal accounting software
finpro.summary: FinPro replaces paper archives and Excel spreadsheets with a central system for VAT, cash flow and AI invoice-to-bank reconciliation.
finpro.problem: Everything was tracked on paper — invoice by invoice, with no clear view of who paid what and when. Messy notes and archives, no control over VAT and the company's cash flow.
finpro.solution: FinPro tracks monthly VAT and cash flow by matching invoices against bank statements. AI reconciles paper and electronic invoices with bank transactions — see every payment status, who owes you, since when and how much has been paid. All organised in one system.
finpro.resultDetail: After rollout, the team processes accounting with 70–80% less manual work. Every payment is traceable — from invoice issue to bank movement.
highlights: Monthly VAT and cash flow control
Clear status for every payment and debt
gallery: Dashboard — financial summary, VAT and monthly control
Periods — quarterly calendar with VAT per month
Invoices — bank reconciliation and invoice management
finpro.coverAlt: FinPro accounting dashboard for VAT and cash flow, web app by Treasure Digital

webShop.solution: We built a new website with a full online store and SEO optimisation — a structure Google can find and a checkout customers actually use.

sussi.title: SUSSI — information storage & sharing management system
sussi.summary: A cloud file platform — fast uploads up to 500 MB, JWT security and a full audit log for every action in the system.
sussi.problem: Files were scattered across local folders and shared drives — slow uploads, zero traceability and a risk of unauthorised access to sensitive documents.
sussi.solution: SUSSI centralises files in a cloud structure with drag-and-drop upload, JWT + bcrypt authentication, audit log with CSV export and brute-force protection — 5 failed attempts lock the account for 15 minutes.
sussi.resultDetail: Teams upload files up to 500 MB with instant feedback, and every upload and access is recorded in the audit log with IP, user and metadata — cloud performance and enterprise security in one system.
highlights: Audit log with export — full traceability
gallery: Login portal — JWT + bcrypt authentication and enterprise UI
Cloud file manager — drag-and-drop upload and folder organisation
Audit log — every action with IP, user and metadata + CSV export
System settings — limits, session timeout and access permissions
sussi.coverAlt: SUSSI cloud file manager with JWT security, built by Treasure Digital

privacy.metaDescription: How Treasure Digital collects, uses and protects your personal data under GDPR.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The data controller is Treasure Digital ("we", "us"). Privacy enquiries: office@treasure-sec.com.
This policy describes how we process data when you visit treasure-digital.com, use contact or audit forms, or communicate with us for business purposes.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: Data you provide voluntarily: name, email, phone (if provided), message content, website URL (audit requests), selected service.
Technical data: IP address, browser type, device, referrer, pages visited — via cookies and analytics (see Cookie Policy) when you have given consent.

sections.title: 3. Purposes and legal basis
paragraphs: Responding to enquiries and quotes — pre-contractual steps or legitimate interest (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) and (f)).
Site improvement and marketing — only with consent for analytics/marketing cookies (Art. 6(1)(a)).
Legal compliance — accounting and contract data when you become a client.

sections.title: 4. Retention
paragraphs: Form enquiries: up to 24 months after last contact, unless you become a client or request earlier deletion.
Contract and financial records: as required by Bulgarian law (typically 5–10 years).

sections.title: 5. Third parties
paragraphs: We use processors for hosting (Vercel), email (Resend) and analytics (Google — with consent). GDPR agreements are in place.
We do not sell personal data. Disclosure only when legally required or with your explicit consent.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port and object to processing, and to withdraw consent at any time.
Complaint to the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (CPDP): www.cpdp.bg.
Requests: office@treasure-sec.com — we respond within 30 days.

sections.title: 7. Security
paragraphs: We apply technical and organisational measures: HTTPS, limited access, data minimisation. No online method is 100% secure; we make reasonable efforts to protect your data.

cookies.metaDescription: What cookies treasure-digital.com uses, why, and how to manage your preferences.
cookies.title: Cookie Policy

sections.title: 1. What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. They help with functionality, statistics and (with consent) marketing.

sections.title: 2. Cookies we use
paragraphs: Strictly necessary: session, language (next-intl), theme (dark/light) — required for the Site to work.
Analytics (Google Analytics via GTM): only after consent — visits, pages, traffic source.
Marketing (Google Ads, Meta Pixel via GTM): only after consent — for ad measurement when enabled.

sections.title: 3. Managing preferences
paragraphs: You can refuse or withdraw consent via browser settings or a future cookie banner on the Site.
Blocking necessary cookies may affect functionality (e.g. remembering language).

sections.title: 4. Duration
paragraphs: Session cookies — until browser close. Persistent — 30 days to 24 months depending on type and third-party settings.
We publish updates to this policy on this page with a new date.

sections.title: 5. Contact
paragraphs: Cookie and privacy questions: office@treasure-sec.com.
